nom: Avène Cicalfate+ Intensive Skin Restorative Serum

avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin due to rosacea and this has helped a lot to restore my barrier that was extremely damaged by improper use of retinols. My skin is extremely soft now and some fine lines have even improved. I saw results after about 2 months of consistent use, along with other prescriptions, but I attribute most of the healing on my face to this product!
The formula of this serum is so so so good for sensitive, rosacea skin! The bottle is awful though, no matter how tight you screw the top on it loosens and leaks during travel

avis.titre: Great serum but the packaging sucks now.
avis.texte: I've been using the Avene Cicalfate for almost a year now. I'm diabetic and my skin was super dry. The serum helped to repair my skin barrier. It's worth the money. Usually. I noticed that my most recent purchase, the packaging changed. The bottle is blue, but the screw neck is much shorter compared to when it had the clear bottle. So the cap easily unscrews if you touch the ring part. I almost spilled the serums if I wasn't lucky. And now the dropper got disconnected. I feel the serum still works for me, but the packaging is so bad.

This is my newest Avène find and an immediate favorite. It adds an extra layer of hydration and repair, especially when my skin is compromised after laser treatments. It absorbs quickly, feels incredibly soothing, and never feels heavy or sticky. The hydration is impressive on its own, but it truly shines when layered under the Cicalfate cream. Together, this combo makes a noticeable difference in calming and restoring irritated skin.

avis.titre: I finally found my go to
avis.texte: I have been on the hunt my entire life for a product that hydrates my skin without clogging my pores. My forehead is smooth my chin is smooth. My skin is hydrated. This is perfect if you clog easily and are prone to comedones or just clogging in general. My face looks amazing. I'm so grateful I gave this product a chance it is my new holy Grail. It's also silicone free. The formulation is PERFECT!!!

I am loving this product to protect and repair my skin barrier during the winter, especially when using retinoids. It also helps calm any redness. I have combination acne- and comedone-pron skin and I have had no issues with this priduct - no clogged pores, no breakouts. HOWEVER the packaging is AWFUL. The lid wont stay tight and The first time I traveled I lost about 1/3 of the product and it's not cheap 😫😫😫 Now when i travel I double-wrap it in cling wrap. One layer under the screw top (I cut a small slit for the dropper) and another layer over top of everything. The lid still loosens but it keeps leaking minimal/zero. Even at home I started to store it upright to be safe.

avis.titre: Absolutely awesome post procedure and just general use aerim
avis.texte: Used after Fraxel session and it accelerated the healing and made my skin even stronger, softer and smoother. Soaks right in, lovely smell - not too strong and really excellent serum.

After burning my face from over exposure to facial nair cream, It looked burned, inflamed, and my face itched/burned. All I did was applied a aloe vera mask for 15 minutes, washed my face with dollar tree wash, and applied this serum with cicaflate before bed. I actual recieved the sample dropper in one of thise guft for purchase deals. The next morning, i could not believe my eyes. I was 85% better. Almost have my face back to normal.
I got a chemical peel and it really did a number on my skin barrier, as its known to do. This calmed and soothed my skin OVERNIGHT.

Ive been having a winter eczema flare up & I used this entire bottle & was disappointed. It didnt really do anything. Didnt really moisture, didnt really soothe, didnt reduce redness or my ezema bumps. It wasnt horrible & did reduces the winter tightness but I was hopng for a lot more pay off especially for the price AND for being for eczema. Not for me.

I have very dry, irritated, sensitive skin around my mouth and nose… tried so many products but nothing worked until I started using this product together with their Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Balm daily morning and night! And about once a week I used their Cicalfate+ restorative protective cream… I am definitely going to buy and try more of their products…
This came in a glass bottle and shattered when I dropped it. I wish the bottle was plastic. I really like the product itself.
After so much trial & error with my skincare needs for my eczema this has been a holy grail in my routine! I am now on my 3rd bottle & will continue to purchase.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive acne prone skin
avis.texte: My skin always has bad reactions to serums, but this has worked wonders. I have already gone through 3 bottles & will never not have this in my nighttime skin care routine. Love love love!

avis.titre: Very Nice Serum for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I ordered 2 bottles of this after finishing 2 deluxe sample bottles. I have highly sensitive, reactive skin that became very red with summer heat which triggered eczema flares and itch all along my jawline. I started using this serum and it really helped calm and normalize everything. I have the type of skin that when inflamed, all of those "soothing" serums/toners/creams/etc. will irritate and sting my skin. (This even happened with the Aven Cicalfate cream!) This serum, however, has not made my skin sting (but I know I still need to be careful). At first I only applied it to my irritated, itchy jawline/lower half of my face, but I saw a YT video where my fave Youtuber Mandy Davis MUA also talked about it as a nice serum for the face, and I agree with her, so I have been using it all over my face once daily, at night before rx treatments.

avis.titre: Break out and dry flakey skin
avis.texte: Im giving it a 2/5 because i only used it once so im giving it the benefit of the doubt. I have acne prone and VERYYYY sensitive skin. I always use a small amount of product (a literal tear drop amount) per side of my face. I woke up with small bumps on certain areas and it made my nose and under my eyebags flakey. I applied makeup and you can see it very This is the only change to my skincare. Thank god it was just a sample.

Background info: i am a women in her early twenties with sensitive and acne prone skin. This product made me break out. Woulnt recommend this produxt because my other avene and physiogel products feel more hydrating without this price tag. Overall its good, just not enough to make me come back for more.

I generally have good resumts with Avene products, but this irritated my skin and dried it out. Its was the only new product i used at the time. I am 50+ witb rosacea and sensitive skin. It was just disappointing.

My skin gets so dry during the winter and I have struggled to find something that helps it feel moisturized. I used the cicalfate cream and loved how it made my skin feel, but it was ultimately too greasy. I tried this as an alternative and it achieves the same effect but feels super lightweight. The only thing I don't love is the price :/ I got this bottle mid-January and it is already over halfway gone. Overall a great product though.

This absorbs well, working with my older combination sensitive skin and hydrates it for the day. I feel like this makes my skin look refeshed without pilling or having a sticky/tacky feeling. Works under sun screen too. I would buy again, since i have trouble finding products that work for me.

This serum is magic. My skin looks and feels amazing, especially around my eyes. I have much less irritation using this along with acne or anti-aging products that would normally cause sensitivity on their own. My skin looks better than it has in years!

This had zero positive effects on my skin. It feels fine upon application and absorbs well enough, but that's about it in terms of positives. Since adding it to my regimen (the only new thing), my roasacea has been worse (redness and bumps), my perioral dermatitis flared up again after being pretty much resolved for 6+ mos, and my skin just felt dry and uncomfortable. I didn't suspect this serum for quite a while because it's marketed as something to help soothe and moisturize. I am a good 3/4 through the bottle, but finally I realized my skin has been getting worse and worse since adding this product into my night routine. A week after stopping this serum, and my skin is so much calmer, perioral dermatitis nearly fully resolved again, and rosacea bumps gone. I learned if it isn't broke, dont try to fix it. I was trying to add an additinal soothing and moisturizing product to my sensitive skin routine for winter, and it ended up having the total opposite effect. Would not recommend.

I was really excited to try this as I love the Cicalfate+ cream by this brand but I was really disappointed when after 2 days my skin started peeling off and felt extremely dry and thick. This product was the only change. I tested this out twice to be sure that this product was what caused the horrible reaction. If you have dry sensitive skin I would stay away from this product. If I could give this 0 stars I would.

As someone who has chronologically dehydrated skin, this has been a miracle. Every type of moisturizer—cream, lotion, gel, water cream—always causes breakouts, especially closed comedones, for me. My skin needs something rich and hydrating but since I'm also acne-prone, my skin hates anything with fatty alcohols. The first day I tried this, my skin looked so plump and refreshed. It's been about a week of using. this as my daily moisturizer and I love it! I can't believe I found something that actually works for my skin.

I never write reviews but i had to for this product! I used to use hylauronic acid as a base and its just so watery. Ive used other serums as well, but they never seemed to do much for me. I only started using rhis a few days ago but already my skin looks so much better and healthier. Absolute must have.
This has forever changed my skin. I bought it on sale, but i would absolutely pay full price because of the way it makes my skin feel!

I am 42 with chronically dry skin, hormonal acne, acne scars, redness, all the fun stuff. I have been using this for a few days now and from the moment i put it on, i feel a rush of hydration and it lasts all day, it feels amazing and very comforting on my skin. I got it on sale and regret not buying more but it's totally worth full price. This serum plays nicely with others. For example, i spray my face with the rose water Mario Badescu spray, use this serum, then Bobbi Brown serum and Bobbi Brown face cream. It's heavenly!!! Cannot recommend enough. Best morning serum.

This product saved my skin after months of trying everything. I've realized that my skin is just not meant for retinoids- regardless of formula, sandwich method, starting extremely slow with no other actives etc. After my last stint of trying retinal (used 2x) i developed a rash that I believe to have been perioral dermatitis. I was so red, itchy, and scaly and burned. Basic moisturizers would burn and make it worse, it seems HA made it worse, tried non-dandruff shampoos in case it was fungal acne and made it worse, tried nothing at all and it made it worse. I had this issue going on for months and felt like any moisturizer I used was irritating. Picked this little miracle serum up and within a week the rash was pretty much gone. It didnt sting my super sensitive skin. And it plays well under my makeup since (tends to lean more silocone based)! Also love that it's one of very few moisturizing products I've found that doesnt contain hyaluronic acid. I don't even care that it's expensive- I will continue buying this and raving about it! Please try it!

I have never left a review before but I had to for this product. I got this serum 8 days ago, have used it morning and night, and it has absolutley CHANGED my skin for the better. I have had adult hormonal acne for 3 years, and my barrier has gotten so bad from it. I tried this totally at random & this is the first time in 3 years I have seen my skin without little breakouts/redness becasue this HEALED my barrier. It is not too heavy, not too light, does not burn at all. Does not pill. No smell. Idk what on earth is in this, but I am so thankful I randomly tried this. It is worth every penny!
This was gentle on my skin. It left my skin looking and feeling soft and hydrated.

avis.titre: Smoother, Less Lines in about a Week
avis.texte: I was skeptical and I already had a daytime and nighttime routine I liked. But I was asked to try Cicalfate+ Intensive Skin Restorative Serum and I was willing to give it a try. I mostly used it at night, although about half the time I also used it during the day. It truly works! My face became a smoother palette for makeup. Most of the time, I don't wear any makeup, just a daytime moisturizer with sunscreen. The tiny lines around my eyes are almost invisible now! It truly is good stuff.

I really didn't notice a positive or negative difference using this product. Obviously, I'm always looking for a holy grail product and was a bit bummed this didn't live up to show any difference. Definitely needs to be have a moisturizer applied right after.
I like Cicalfate+. It feels very soothing on irritated skin. It is a bit thick so I apply it at night. I have normal to dry skin. My skin feels less dry these days. I will continue to use Cicalfate+
It makes my face look and feel younger. Thank you for the sample.
Love how this serum firms up and hydrates my skin right away! Don't need too much so its well worth your money
I enjoyed using this serum. It is lightweight but hydrating and moisturizing. Also gentle and soothing- feels nice when my skin is irritated.
I absolutely loved these serum and the way it made my face feel after applying it to my face. It was non-irritating and silky smooth.
For the size of the sample, I was hesitant I would see or feel results but WOW! The product packs a punch.

I was thrilled to find my sample (and a good sized one, at that) in my mailbox!! Upon following the directions, and despite initially liking the consistency and the no fragrence; i found that it was a bit drying, and my face felt "tight". As we enter the colder months, I need a much more hydrating type of serum.
I try this obviously for a couple days and I can see my skin really better so I would recommend and I buy for me

I enjoyed the fast-absorbing and lightweight nature of this product. I am already a fan of cica for skincare. I struggle with some combination skin with more dryness in the winter months. My skin tends to feel dehydrated and in need of moisture. I also struggle with moisture barrier (keeping moisture in) due to some auto-immune issues that affect my overall skin's health. This product was hydrating and calming. I would definitely add this to my skincare routine!
I noticed a bit of a difference so I believe linger use will have a great effect. I'll definitely make a purchase of this product.
This serum surprised me by how well it works! It feels so good on my skin the instant I put it on

I loved the serum. It felt really thick for s serum which I really liked because a little went a long way. Im still using the small sample bottle. I plan getting more before I run out. It so smooth on the fast and isn't sticky. Makes my face feeling really refreshed after washing it and then putting on the serum. It's an amazing product. Must-have in every girls skincare routine !
i really like this serum. not oily or greasy. great at hydrating the skin. gives a nice glowy and firm feeling. Will differently be putting this in my skin care routine
I like this serum. It absorbs well & leaves me feeling like my skin is more firm & yet still hydrated. I appreciate the benefits as I'm in skin recovery myself.

I enjoyed using this restorative serum. It had little to no scent. My face felt soft and moisturized after every use. I didn't have any sudden reaction or breakouts. It's a solid product even if I didn't notice any improvements to my skin.
I can't really tell if it's doing anything but it feels good going on
Excellent serum to use with red light therapy. Highly recommend.
For Sensitive skin and damage skin barrier this is magic in a battle my skin is loving it
I wish the bottle had of been bigger but it's a good serum you just don't need to put to much on cause it will look white on your face
I really truly enjoyed your product, it rejuvenated my skin leaving it baby soft smooth & hydrated just as it said it would do. Amazing product and is a must tryðŸ¤©
I love this serum and have only been using it for a few weeks. It's hydrating, left my skin feeling smooth and didn't break me out either.
I started using the first night. The next morning I could tell the serum helped my face.

I have never tried a product from this brand that did not deliver. This serum really enhanced my skin and calmed some of the issues I have, having combination skin. My skin felt hydrated, nurtured and as though a protective barrier between my skin and toxins was created. I would still feel the product when I washed my face later. Loved it and will buy again!
I loved the way my skin felt after using it. It wasn't harsh on my very sensitive skin. I plan on purchasing it once I use my sample up.
Have only used for a couple days, but it appears to have made a difference in my skin's appearance.
enjoyed my product trial. serum works well. my skin felt rejuvinated

Very clean but powerful stuff. A little went a long way. I appreciate that it doesn't have a lingering overpowering smell like most serums do
This serum has really helped restore moisture to my face. I love how glowy i look after using this product. Definitely recommend trying this.

avis.titre: calmed the dryness, made my face feel soft , moisturized and
avis.texte: My face sometimes has a dry tight feeling and looks moisture depleted. It absorbed quickly with no tacky feeling, gentle on my skin and has no scent. Also contain pro vitamin B-5 TRP-Regulin. I highly recommend this product and now a part of my daily skin routine.

I really enjoyed this product and it definitely did leave my skin feeling clean and protected. Definitely needs to be followed by a moisturizing product.
Cicalfate+intensive Skin Restorative Serum is a game changer! This product is worth a try folks! Best Serum I've used yet!
I love the product . It didn't have a smell absorbed very well my skin didn't have a reaction

I started using this in my normal routine and it did not disappoint. Not sticky, soaks into the skin pretty fast doesn't leave behind a layer on your face. Great product light and gel like constitancy leaves mt skin feeling very hydrated a little goes a long way this has no scent

After trying Cicalfate+ Intensive Skin Restorative Serum my skin was looking good. Definitely recommend.
I find the product effective and hydrating. It improves skin tone, and softness. It was extremely small sample so it's hard to prove more detailed review.

I have been using this Cicalfate+ Serum as part of my skincare routine. I like how easy it is to use and that it absorbs quickly. It doesn't irritate my skin. I have noticed my skin looks better hydrated and has a nice glow to it. My skin feels nice and balanced.
